general.description: Set up business payment entry points, payment accounts, cashier profiles and API access.

list.sublineEmpty: Add an entry point, grant payment accounts and configure its cashier or API integration.
list.deleteModalMessage: Delete "{app}"? Its payment orders are kept, but its secret stops working right away.

detail.notFound: This business entry point is no longer available.
detail.cardApplicationSubtitle: Manage the app that starts payments and opens cashier sessions.
detail.labelTechnicalNameHelpText: The app_id the external app sends with every request.
detail.labelActiveHelpText: An inactive app cannot start payments anymore.
detail.cardSecuritySubtitle: Where the payment results are reported, the secret that signs the requests, and who may call the payment api.
detail.labelRateLimitHelpText: Requests per minute, empty means unlimited.
detail.labelAppSecretHelpText: Left empty, the stored secret stays unchanged.
detail.placeholderAllowedIps: One IP per line, empty means every IP
detail.labelAllowedIpsHelpText: Only the listed IPs may call the payment api.
detail.secretHint: The secret is shown once, copy it now and keep it safe, it cannot be read again.
detail.cardAccountSubtitle: Select payment accounts and set their routing priority. Merchant credentials are managed in Payment accounts.
detail.cardChannelSubtitle: Choose the products this app may offer. Grant a payment account for the provider before enabling its products.
detail.secretModalMessage: Copy and store the secret now, it cannot be read again.
detail.deleteModalMessage: Delete "{app}"? Its payment orders are kept, but its secret stops working right away.
detail.sharedAccountHint: This account is managed elsewhere. You can change this app’s grant and routing priority here.
detail.noGrants: Add an existing payment account to let this app collect payments.

cashier.title: Cashier profiles
cashier.description: Create a profile for each business entry point. Available payment methods also depend on the granted accounts and products.
cashier.empty: Add a profile to offer a cashier for this business entry point.
cashier.identifierHelp: Use this identifier when opening a cashier session, for example h5 or wechat_mini. Custom identifiers are supported.
cashier.methodsHelp: Leave empty to allow all available payment methods.
cashier.failed: The cashier configuration could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
cashier.saveAppFirst: Save this business entry point before adding cashier profiles.
